column1: # Synthetic IEC 60870-5-104 APDUs for the iec104 decoder tests.
# Every vector is hand-built from the standard layouts, not captured:
# IEC 60870-5-104 Ed.2.0 clause 5 (APCI) and the IEC 104 parameters (COT 2,
# CA 2, IOA 3 octets), and IEC 60870-5-101 Ed.2.0 7.2 (data unit identifier,
# information elements) and 7.3 (ASDUs). "104 time-tagged" marks the command
# ASDUs with CP56Time2a that IEC 104 adds (58-64, 107); monitor types 30-37
# also carry CP56Time2a. Clause numbers are to be verified against the
# licensed text. Reference captures are documented in test/iec104/testdata/README.md
# and are labelled separately from synthetic vectors.
# Format: one APDU stream per line, tab-separated:
#   name  direction(c=client to server, s=server to client)  kinds  hex  reference
# kinds lists the event kinds in order, or frame_error for bytes that cannot
